title: Welcome to The Career Growth Summit by Teal
description:
Welcome to the Career Growth Summit by Teal! If you have not already signed up, registration is still open! Sign up here: https://careergrowthsummit.tealhq.com/ 

We'd like to peronally welcome you to what is sure to be an incredible event. We have well over 30 hours of content with amazing speakers! 

Join Teal on October 21 & 22 and Take Control of Your Career
Teal’s Career Growth Summit is a virtual event aimed at helping professionals navigate their career growth. Over the course of 2 days, we’re bringing together established professionals and experts in the career space to run round tables, workshops, and virtual networking sessions to help you put yourself in the best position to find, land and grow in a job you love.

Teal has empowered thousands of professionals to grow their careers and take control of their career paths through our 4-week Programs. If you or someone you know is looking to gain certainty and be more productive in managing their careers, take the first step in investing in yourself and reserve your spot at this free event.

Topics will include:

Learn to navigate the changing career landscape
Teal is bringing together both career experts and business executives to talk about how they’ve navigated challenges to achieve amazing career growth.

Engage with other professionals on career growth journeys
The best way to explore new career paths is to talk to other professionals about theirs. Our round table and networking events will help you source new perspectives and grow your network.

Supercharge your career growth
Our second day will be focused around tactically improving your career growth. Join our sessions, get live guidance on defining your career path, searching for fulfilling work and leveraging work styles to grow your career.

Schedule:

Day One: Career Speaker Series
10:30 am — 6:00pm ET
Learn from our speakers' expertise and get inspired by their own career journeys. Most of our workshops, roundtables, & fireside chats will be interactive, so come ready to ask questions and participate.

Day Two: Career Workshops
11:00 am — 5:00pm ET
We’ve broken up the job search process into 4 workshops mixed in with live review sessions for our Career Guides and recruiters to help you improve everything from your LinkedIn to your resume.
